scope: Acquisition and project integration ledger. Imported counts describe observations, not complete engineering-grade specifications.

sources.name: NASA TPSX
sources.access: Public material list endpoint and material HTML pages; bulk export labeled Coming Soon
sources.licenseStatus: No dataset-wide reuse license verified; preserve NASA/industry database identity and original property references

probe.sampleEvidence: Measured values with uncertainties and a cited thermophysical report; density conditions marked assumed

sources.acquisitionResult: All 1,549 list records acquired; 1,545 detail pages imported. Four detail endpoints repeatedly return HTTP 500 (1519, 773, 1051, 1258).

sources.name: NASA Goddard Outgassing
sources.sourceSnapshot: Legacy tenth compilation; catalog updated 2025, embedded rows timestamp 2015. Not claimed to be the current live database.
sources.access: Complete JSON downloaded and parsed; all rows have the declared 18 columns
sources.adapterRequirements: Add outgassing property definitions/constraints and retain cure, manufacturer, source sample/row IDs; sample ID alone is not unique. Do not invent mechanical properties.
sources.acquisitionResult: Complete legacy NASA JSON snapshot; vacuum properties, conditions and selection limits implemented.

sources.name: NIST Cryogenic Materials Properties
sources.access: Public HTML coefficient tables; regenerator spreadsheet additionally linked
sources.licenseStatus: Free reference access verified; specific republication terms not verified
sources.adapterRequirements: Store correlations, applicable temperature ranges, fit errors and references. Evaluate only within ranges. Linear expansion is not the same quantity as expansion coefficient.
sources.acquisitionResult: Direct index and material requests return HTTP 403, error code 1010. No correlation values imported.

sources.name: NIST Alloy Data
sources.access: Public application found; downloadable schema/API not probed in this audit
sources.properties: Experimental thermophysical metal/alloy data with original publication provenance and uncertainty
sources.licenseStatus: Dataset/service reuse terms require source-specific verification
sources.acquisitionResult: Public application request returns HTTP 403. No bulk dataset retrieved.

sources.name: Full JARVIS-DFT
sources.access: jarvis-tools downloads / Figshare / OPTIMADE; full archive not downloaded
sources.evidence: Computed crystalline-material properties; engineering tensile strength and supplier condition are not implied
sources.licenseStatus: Figshare version 10 explicitly lists CC BY 4.0; version 11 (2026-05-09) is listed but its license metadata was not successfully retrieved. Reverify selected version before import.
sources.adapterRequirements: Potentially enrich existing JARVIS IDs with chemical identity and computed density; preserve per-property provenance and avoid duplicating existing benchmark entries.
sources.acquisitionResult: Figshare hosts resolve to a NextDNS block page and fail TLS verification. TLS was not disabled and filtering was not bypassed. Existing 19,335 pinned JARVIS elastic benchmark records remain available.

sources.name: Materials Project
sources.access: Public S3 build bucket listing verified without credentials; MP API requires a free account API key
sources.properties: Computed crystal structures, density, elastic, electronic, dielectric and other property subsets
sources.licenseStatus: AWS registry links MP Terms of Use; terms endpoint returned 403. Do not apply one license to every MP subcollection.
sources.adapterRequirements: Select summary/elasticity products, retain calculation IDs/methods, and exclude restricted collections unless separately authorized.
sources.acquisitionResult: Full public summary/elasticity Parquet snapshots downloaded; 154,377 core and 116,948 GNoME non-deprecated records imported under separate licenses. 8,834 deprecated summary records remain in raw files and are excluded from screening.

sources.name: NOMAD
sources.access: Public repository/archive and APIs documented; bulk endpoint not probed
sources.scale: Millions of FAIR records advertised; not a count of distinct complete engineering grades
sources.licenseStatus: Publisher documentation describes published repository/archive data as CC BY 4.0
sources.adapterRequirements: Import selected public datasets using their schemas, units and provenance; avoid duplicate calculations from other databases.
sources.acquisitionResult: Complete public query tagged with bulk_modulus or shear_modulus; published state and CC BY 4.0 checked per entry. The full OPTIMADE archive advertises 18,839,485 records and was not downloaded.

sources.name: Alexandria
sources.access: Public downloads and OPTIMADE interface; download directory 2025.07.02 verified
sources.scale: NIST JARVIS download documentation lists the 3D PBE collection at 5 million data points; not locally counted
sources.licenseStatus: CC BY 4.0 explicitly stated by publisher
sources.properties: DFT-relaxed inorganic crystal geometries, energies, convex hulls and selected phonon data
sources.adapterRequirements: Suitable for crystal-discovery research; do not create tensile or service-temperature values from structure/energy data.
sources.acquisitionResult: All 59 published PBE 3D archives downloaded and SHA-256 recorded. Normalization is in progress; full raw structures retained. Other PBEsol/SCAN/low-dimensional collections are not claimed downloaded.

sources.name: AFLOW
sources.access: REST/AFLUX API documented; no bulk archive downloaded
sources.licenseStatus: AFLUX documentation restricts repository data use to scientific, academic and noncommercial purposes
sources.adapterRequirements: Select actual AEL/AGL subsets with property-specific units and temperatures; full database count does not imply full property coverage.
sources.acquisitionResult: Complete union of available AEL Voigt bulk modulus and AGL 300 K conductivity queries. Source returned 5,639 elastic and 5,653 thermal entries; AUID duplicates combined. Scientific/academic/non-commercial restriction retained.

sources.name: OQMD
sources.access: Public API without credentials and MySQL dump documented; direct page requests returned 502 during this audit
sources.licenseStatus: No current dataset reuse license verified from primary documentation
sources.properties: DFT thermodynamic and structural properties; limited relevance to supplier-grade mechanical screening
sources.adapterRequirements: Prefer targeted API queries over loading a separate roughly 100 GB MySQL installation.
sources.acquisitionResult: Download and formation-energy API requests return HTTP 502. The advertised 21.1 GB compressed SQL dump / roughly 100 GB MySQL installation does not fit this workspace disk capacity.

sources.name: NASA MAPTIS
sources.access: Registered accounts; current notice says cost-sharing/payment effective January 2026
sources.licenseStatus: Access-controlled NASA and commercial collections, including ASM/Granta/MMPDS; not a public open-data download
sources.acquisitionResult: No MAPTIS credentials or approved export are present. Registered access/payment is required by publisher.

sources.licenseStatus: Free viewing does not authorize bulk import. NIMS MDR is a separate repository requiring dataset-level assessment.
sources.acquisitionResult: No licensed bulk export present. Publisher prohibits scraping/mass acquisition from browsing service; no scraping attempted.
